title: Connections Of The crimson swine
paragraphs: “Motoyasu…”
“Well, it’s tough for the Shield Hero without any companions.”
“How will this be handled? Redistribution due to vacancies?”

Oh? Ren and Itsuki seem a little suspicious. Meanwhile, that trash is whispering to the minister, looking annoyed, pretending he didn’t know anything. No doubt, he’s planning to spread nonsense about Father’s lack of knowledge or some other lies. Well, just like last time, I told Ren and Itsuki that the Shield is the strongest when it comes to defense. They must have eavesdropped on the conversation I had with Father, which included that explanation. …Of course, I was fully aware of it.
“Hmm, such rumors have been spreading, have they…?”
“Is something the matter?”
What a farce.
What’s this nonsense about being ignorant of the world’s laws? If that’s the case, the heroes should simply have a meeting to share knowledge.
Isn’t that exactly what the queen would suggest? Establishing coordination and sharing information?
“Hmm, actually… there’s a rumor circulating within the castle that the Shield Hero is ignorant of the world’s laws.”
“Huh!?”
“The legends state that the heroes understand the laws of this world. There’s talk that he may not meet that condition.”
At this point, Itsuki pats Father’s shoulder and murmurs. No change here.
“They must have overheard our conversation yesterday.”

Father unreliable? If you’ve seen the previous loops, you’d know he’s perfectly capable of managing the other heroes as allies. In the first place, there’s plenty of merit in having heroes cooperate instead of working separately without reason. There’s absolutely no intention to establish coordination. Leaving everything to the heroes during the waves, believing that alone will solve everything—that kind of naive thinking only increases the damage. They’re underestimating the world. Father yells at Ren, expressing his frustration about having to set out alone. No changes here either. I’d love to serve those pigs up to him, but acting rashly could trigger failure.
“Motoyasu, what do you think? Isn’t this awful?”
Ah… this rare tone of mixed camaraderie and envy from Father… it’s enough to make me swoon.
“What are you spacing out for!?”
“Maybe he’s still too excited?”
“What’s with that smug look after surrounding yourself with women? Just because you’re good-looking! Damn it!”
Father is cursing at me with a look of envy.
Women? These are pigs. I feel no joy from it, but Father’s words strike straight to my heart.
What am I supposed to do with these pigs, who believe they’re fit for battle just because they’re dressed up? These pig-like prostitutes are nothing but a hindrance in battle.

Why prioritize these pests who pollute the air just by existing and gnaw away at the world? Maybe I should hand them all over to the pig king of Faubrey? If I use my authority as a hero, they won’t be able to resist.
“It would be better to split them evenly, three for each hero… but forcing it might affect morale.”
“So I’m supposed to set out alone!?”

Don’t worry. I remember. Father is never truly alone. I’m with him, and this time, the big sister will be by his side too. I won’t let anything fail. And even if it does, the Filolials will protect Father.
“Buu!”
Hmph! That crimson swine dares to step forward and taint my memories.

Here it comes—the scourge of this world, the crimson swine that nearly brought destruction to Melromarc! I won’t let you die easily this time. Killing you thoughtlessly causes disasters in Melromarc. But I will definitely put an end to you. You’re Fleon-chan’s enemy, after all.
“Oh? Is that fine?”
“Buu.”
Father looks slightly embarrassed.
Do not be deceived! The urge to protect him immediately, just like before, is overwhelming. I will absolutely protect Father.

However… the crimson swine’s demeanor at this moment strangely overlaps with the way big Sister’s sister used to lead Father. Ah, yes… last time, Father confessed to big Sister’s sister that he was weak when someone took the lead in protecting him. Surely, the crimson swine’s behavior is stirring similar emotions in him. If I were to criticize her now and expose her deceit, Father wouldn’t trust me. No, knowing that crimson swine, she’d definitely take some suspicious action against me. I need to be extremely careful.
“Is there no one else willing to join Naofumi-dono?”
Crimson swine, your schemes and selfish actions end today. Heh heh heh heh heh.

“It can’t be helped. Naofumi-dono, you will have to recruit companions of your liking and supplement your ranks yourself. I will distribute the monthly support funds, but as compensation, you will receive a larger share compared to the other heroes.”
“Y-Yes!”
Father, unaware of the malice in this world, nodded.
Money? I can gather more than enough later. There’s no need to get excited over pocket change like this. Besides, compared to Faubrey, this amount is laughably small.
“Naofumi-dono will receive 800 silver coins, while the other heroes will receive 600. Use this to prepare your equipment and set out on your journey.”
“Yes!”
“Buu!”

I salute with a firm resolve to kill those pigs. Now then, there’s a lot to take care of today. Ren and Itsuki’s accommodations won’t change, so I’ll focus on the tasks I was entrusted with in the previous loop. Of course, purchasing Yuki-chan and the others will have to wait. Ah, I’d love to use this free time to go buy them immediately, but I was asked to do something else, so there’s no choice. The situation is complicated, after all. I have to act within the limits of what I remember, and gaining trust requires following the necessary steps.
“Bubu!”
Every time, the pigs are saying something. I don’t understand at all. As always, I’ll imitate Ren.

Should I show a little disappointment to make it more like Ren? Well, there’s no need to bother with such courtesy for pigs. Now then, Ren and Itsuki… they’re behaving exactly the same as last time. Ren really loves getting a head start.

As for me, I’ll do what I always do—blend into the crowd and use Portal at the corner! Then, I teleported to a certain location… and took a little too long gaining their trust. By the time I returned, the sun was already setting.
“Well then, later… let’s see. Please wait for me in front of that tavern.”

The hooded figures nodded silently. I used the remaining time before the cooldown ended to secure an inn. Otherwise, that crimson swine would figure out where I was. Soon enough, the pigs gathered from who knows where, looking flustered.
“Where have you been? I’ll have to report this to the king.”
“Bububuu!”

They’re saying something, but I don’t understand a thing. Well, your positions will only last until tomorrow. In any case, preparations are complete. The information about the inn I secured should reach the crimson swine soon. So, she’ll definitely come to the tavern attached to the inn. For now, securing Ren should be the priority. Itsuki will likely come to the tavern soon as well. …Though considering the cooldown of the return portal, I should shake off the pigs and then go meet them.
“Ren, it’s me!”
“Hm? Motoyasu?”

As expected, Ren was still fighting plant-type monsters. Everything is going according to plan. Last time, I searched desperately, but knowing where he is makes it easy to find him now. All I have to do is follow the same words and actions as last time. Father and the others said it’s best to act the same way as before. Ren and Itsuki agreed, so this is the best approach.
“What’s wrong? Why are you here?”
“To explain that, I need to follow a few steps.”
“What are you talking about?”
“First…”
I send Ren a party invitation.
“What’s with the sudden invitation? Don’t heroes repel each other when they fight together?”
“I’m not planning to hunt. I want Ren to come with me.”
“Why?”
“It’s information you should know.”
The same exchange as last time. I’m doing this because I know it’ll work. This is just a necessary ritual.
“Sorry, but I was planning to hunt a little longer.”
Oh? This reaction is different from last time. Ah, come to think of it, the timing is slightly off from before. I might have been a little early.
“Well, I was only planning to hunt for about 30 more minutes…”
Ren agreed to the invitation, though it felt a bit like he was doing me a favor.
Got him!
“Then, let’s go. Portal Spear!”
“Huh?”
In an instant, we teleported to the inn where Itsuki was staying in Melromarc. So far, everything is unfolding exactly as it did last time.
“Teleportation skill? You shouldn’t be able to learn that yet. How can you use it?”
“I’ll explain everything later, but now isn’t the time. Please wait here for a moment.”
“Well, if it’s just waiting…”
This should pique Ren’s curiosity. Now then… looking over at the tavern… it seems Itsuki just arrived and is happily chatting away.
“Did I come too early?”
Last time, Itsuki noticed me and came over, but this time, he hasn’t noticed yet.
“Isn’t that Itsuki? Do you need something from him too?”
Ren looks around the tavern suspiciously.
“Yes, but… I seem to be a little early.”

Ren tilts his head repeatedly. For now, I’ll take Ren and kill some time. Ren keeps asking how I obtained the portal skill. It’s good to have a strong curiosity for the unknown, but calm down. After about 30 minutes, when Itsuki was done chatting, he finally noticed me. I beckoned him over.
“Oh? Motoyasu-san, and even Ren. What’s going on?”
“I was brought here by Motoyasu, and I’m just as surprised.”
“Haa…”
Itsuki looks at me.
“I need to talk with just the heroes for a moment, so please come with me.”
“What’s this about?”
“Yeah, can’t we talk here? I’ve already waited about 30 minutes for Itsuki.”
“Seeing is believing, as they say. I called you both because it’s faster if you see it for yourselves.”
“Huh?”
“I don’t know what you’re planning, but if you’ll explain how you obtained the portal skill, I’ll come along.”
“Portal skill?”
This part is the same as last time. I’m explaining the portal skill now.
“If you follow me, I’ll explain.”
“Understood.”
“Well, it doesn’t seem like a bad thing.”
Itsuki told his companions that he would spend some time bonding with the other heroes and left the tavern.
“Now then…”
I motioned to the two figures in robes who were sitting in front of the tavern.
“These people will be coming with us as well.”
“Isn’t this just for the heroes?”
“Come now, just follow me without asking too much. I was surprised at first as well.”
“W-What is this about?”
“This isn’t something illegal, right?”
I met Itsuki’s suspicious gaze head-on. This was the time when Itsuki was obsessed with justice.
“On the contrary, this will allow us to correct something that is wrong.”
“Huh?”
“This isn’t a trap, is it? You’re not taking us somewhere to kill us, right?”
“Of course not. We may be from different worlds, but we’re all Japanese, aren’t we?”

Using the psychological effect of being more trusting of fellow countrymen abroad, I guided Ren and Itsuki. Following the same path as before, I used magic to conceal myself as I advanced through the back alleys. As expected, Ren and Itsuki were talking about the same things as before while we moved through the alleys. Eventually, I reached the area near the inn where Father was resting.
“Ren, Itsuki, excuse me for a moment.”
“Huh? Whoa!”
“W-What—”
Just like last time, I grabbed Ren and Itsuki and jumped onto the roof of a nearby building. I carefully set them down so they wouldn’t get hurt.
Oh? The two robed figures used magic to follow us up.
“What’s going on!?”
“Shhh… quiet. Otherwise, the lookouts will notice us.”
“Lookouts? What are you so worried about? What’s ahead?”
“Naofumi is staying at that inn.”
“Huh? You’re bringing Naofumi too?”
“Well… it’s only natural since we’re all heroes. But seriously, how did you manage to jump up to the roof while carrying us?”
“I’ll explain that step by step as well.”

At this point, Itsuki was still full of questions. He hadn’t fully understood what was happening yet. We moved along the rooftops and arrived above Father’s room. Of course, the attic. When we entered the attic, one of my helpers lit a fire spell to illuminate the area.
“Ah, thank you.”
When Itsuki expressed his gratitude, the helper waved it off as if to say not to worry.
“Now then…”
I opened a few holes in the roof above Father’s room. Ren, Itsuki, and the helpers all peered inside.
“Naofumi-san is just resting, isn’t he?”
“Just another… 30 minutes or so of patience.”
Last time, I had to wait about that long. It should be the same now.
“Um… we’re not here to play ninja with you, Motoyasu-san.”
Just as Itsuki whispered that, looking slightly irritated, Father stood up, did some preparations, and then went back to sleep.
“See, Naofumi-san went back to sleep.”
“I’d like to rest soon too…”
“I was planning to spend more time with my companions.”
“After you witness what happens next, you can complain all you want. If you’re still not satisfied, I’ll give you all the money I have.”
“Well… if you’re that confident…”
“Yeah… if it doesn’t take too long, fine.”
About 20 minutes passed.
“This position is getting uncomfortable. My back is starting to hurt.”
“Should I use magic that lets you see in the dark? I can also cast healing magic for your back.”
“Where did you learn magic like that?”
“I’m sure it’s ‘something that happens next.’ Let’s stay quiet.”
The helper casually cast a spell that allowed Ren and Itsuki to see in the dark.
“Oh, I can see much better now.”
I carefully cast a spell to prevent sound from leaking out.
“By the way, who are these people?”
“Itsuki, it’s probably related to ‘what happens next.’”
“I can explain right now if you’d like. But keep your voices down.”
Ren and Itsuki slowly turned their faces toward me.
“Then, tell us.”
“Yeah.”
Well, I suppose I have no choice. I gestured to the two helpers.
“It’s—”
At that moment, we heard the sound of the door opening. Unaware that we were watching, the crimson swine walked in.
“Huh? Isn’t that one of Naofumi-san’s companions?”
“They’re companions, so it’s normal for them to share a room.”
“But… I heard the sound of a key turning. I saw that Naofumi-san left the key on the table when he went to bed.”
“A separate room from his companions…? Then how did they get in? No… maybe they had a spare key.”
“That’s possible, but… something feels off.”

Hmph… crimson swine, you’ve walked right into the trap. The crimson swine rifled through Father’s belongings, taking the bag of money, the chainmail, and the clothes he had worn. Ren and Itsuki watched intently through the holes.
“Sister…”
The helper, who was… Fiancée, muttered softly, half in disbelief, with her hand on her forehead.
“Maybe it’s a surprise to wash them secretly?”
“Then why take the money? That’s clearly…”
Kukuku… yes. Crimson swine, reveal your filthy heart, as filthy as your appearance. There are plenty of witnesses here to expose your crimes.
You are already… surrounded!
“Bubu, bubububu…”
Muttering something incriminating, the crimson swine finally left the room. Ren and Itsuki remained frozen, unable to move for a while.
“Did you hear what Naofumi-san’s companion just said?”
“Yeah, that sounded… like theft.”
“Do you understand now?”
“Well, I saw Naofumi’s companion committing theft, but… what’s the point of showing us this? I mean… I feel sorry for him, and I do intend to tell him who the culprit is, but…”

Ren and Itsuki are convinced now. This is exactly the same as last time. Now then… I glance toward the helper. Shaking with suppressed anger, the helper—who was connected to the crimson swine… the queen—was trembling with rage.
Chapter 757 – Surveillance
Eventually, Itsuki also turned to face us with that self-righteous look.
“The interrogation comes later.”
“Why!? That was theft! It’s a crime! We should catch her red-handed!”
“That’s impossible. She’s this country’s princess, and tomorrow, Father—no, Naofumi—will be falsely accused of being a rapist and dragged to the castle.”
“What!?”
“The mastermind is her. The perpetrator is the pig, and that pig will cry fake tears, claiming to be the victim of assault. How does that look to those who don’t know the truth?”
“A p-pig? Well, I can’t say I don’t get where you’re coming from…”
My mouth had reached its limit after explaining this all over again. Ren started thinking it through.
“Motoyasu, is this what you wanted to show us?”
“There’s still more, but I forgot to explain something earlier.”
“No, I think it’s too soon to reveal my identity to the heroes,” the queen, who had been trembling while suppressing her anger, suggested to me.
“Is that so?”
“Yes… Melty. If Aultcray and Malty are allowed to talk their way out of this, it will be a hassle. For now, watch over the Shield Hero while he sleeps tonight.”
“U-Understood.”
Fiancée nodded at the queen’s words. Keeping watch for an entire night is quite a task.
“Um… who is that person…?”
Itsuki, looking dumbfounded at the queen’s words, turned his gaze to me.
“Just a little longer.”
“Yes, let’s wait until we witness that fool’s misconduct.”
“Understood.”
“But…”
“Itsuki, something is happening behind the scenes that we don’t know about, and it seems Motoyasu knows. It looks like a farce, but let’s go along with it until the end. It might be entertaining.”
“Even you, Ren? *Sigh*… Fine.”
“So? What happens next?”
“When I’m drinking at the tavern, she’ll come with the chainmail she stole and offer it as a gift. When I refuse, she’ll take it to Itsuki next and offer it to him.”
“That’s quite a revelation.”
“Giving away stolen goods… if that’s true.”
“…That girl would do something like that.”
Ugh… talking to her disgusts me, but I’ll endure it. Itsuki wouldn’t like it, and if Ren is discovered, it will arouse suspicion.
“Heroes, please take these robes.”
The queen handed robes to Ren and Itsuki.
“Kitamura-sama, I’m counting on you.”
“Leave it to me!”
Thus, we discreetly headed to the tavern and lured out the crimson swine. Just like last time, she came waddling over.
“Bubububu…”
“Indeed. Haha, yes.”

Every time I wonder… why do the pig and her kind think they’re having a conversation just by giving empty responses? Is it that? I recall Father once muttering that pigs think of men as ATMs. Yes, that must be it. Conversations between pigs and humans don’t align. It’s as if they expect men to operate mechanically as programmed. In that regard, Filo is amusing. If I were to give her empty responses like that, she’d keep asking “Why? Why?” and eventually pout. Well, I usually give in before that happens, but in the first world, Father didn’t budge. The previous Father deflected questions by asking more questions in return. Either way, it shows how skilled he is at handling Filo. The crimson swine proudly handed me the incriminating chainmail.
Fufufufu…
“Bu?”
“A-Are you sure?”
“Bubububu!”

I suppressed my laughter as I pretended to accept the stolen item while enduring the nauseating sight of the pig’s smile. The crimson swine left, satisfied. Ren, Itsuki, and the queen, who was barely containing her rage, watched the whole thing unfold from hiding. Ren and Itsuki seemed to be trembling, trying to stay unnoticed. I casually left the tavern and headed for the back alley. Of course, I cast a spell to flush out anyone hiding while preventing any sound from leaking. Ren and Itsuki quickly followed, as if they were running from the queen.
“We’ve secured the evidence. At dawn, she’ll come to wake me up at my inn.”
“No… this can’t be… it’s actually true… What is going on?”
“Why is everything happening exactly as you said? Is this some kind of play? Or a prank? No, I can’t imagine you’d go through all this just to fool us.”
“More importantly… who exactly is that person?”
“Then allow me to introduce her. She is the true ruler of Melromarc. The queen.”
“Huh?”
I introduced the queen to Ren and Itsuki. The queen pulled back her hood and gave a slight bow.
“Nice to meet you. I am Mirelia Q. Melromarc, the ruler of this kingdom.”

Yes, that’s right. Back when Father was still here, I had asked the queen where she had been when we were first summoned. It was quite the ordeal to bring her here. After shaking off the pigs, I used the portal to warp to where the queen was. At first, I thought the queen was somewhere around Faubrey, but she was actually engaged in diplomacy in a country a little further away near Faubrey. Apparently, she was staying there to witness the summoning of the heroes. Although I used the portal, the castle was a bit further away. Since I don’t have everything mapped out, and considering that she was moving around by the hour, taking the nearest location caused a significant loss of time.
“Excuse me!”
“Who are you!?”
I approached the castle where the queen was staying that day from the front. The castle guards blocked my path.
“I am the Spear Hero, one of the Four Holy Heroes summoned yesterday. I know that the queen of Melromarc is here.”
“The Spear Hero? Stop spouting nonsense!”

Apparently, the news that the Four Holy Heroes had been summoned together had not yet been acknowledged by the world. Or rather, it seemed like Faubrey had just discovered it and was in the process of notifying other countries. So, it’s no wonder they were behind on this information.
“Do you still not believe me?”
To prove that I was a hero, I demonstrated the ability to change the shape of my weapon at will.
“Hmph, that’s nothing special. Impersonating a hero is a serious crime! Arrest him!”

A group of soldiers emerged and surrounded me. They don’t believe me… how troublesome. Impersonating a hero is indeed a crime. They probably thought there was no way the real one would show up. I want to tell them to just report it to their superiors already.
“Be quiet and surrender!”
The soldiers pointed their weapons at me and tried to force my surrender, but that’s basically how it always goes.
“How annoying.”
I gripped my spear tightly and swung it. Just that created a violent gust of wind.
“Uwaaaaaaaaah!”
The soldiers were blown away by the wind of my swing.
“T-This guy! He’s strong! I don’t know what kind of magic he’s using, but if you resist the kingdom’s soldiers, you won’t get away with it!”
“If you keep this up, I’ll kill you.”
“Attack him!”
As the soldiers called for reinforcements, I reluctantly decided to use my skills.
“Aiming Lancer!”
I threw my spear high, piercing through the soldiers around me. Since killing them would be a hassle, I held back.
“Gwaaaaaaah!”
“Uwaaaaaah!”
Soldiers all around me collapsed, groaning in pain.
“Buhiieeeeeeeee!”
A pig-like pedestrian near the castle screamed.
Annoying.
Should I kill you too?
“Ugh… ugh…”
“D-Don’t let him enter the castle! Protect the king and the guests with your lives!”
“Oooooh!”
More and more soldiers kept pouring out. Father told me not to kill anyone and just talk to the queen. Avoiding fatal wounds is a hassle.
“Great Whirlwind!”
I activated a skill that spun my spear around me. When the level is high, a tornado forms as an additional effect.
“Gyaaaaaaah!”
The soldiers were swept up by the tornado and sent flying.
“Dieeee!”
Even the arrows from the archers were knocked down. This is such a pain. I pressed forward into the castle without killing anyone.
“Paralyze Lance! Meteor Spear!”
I mowed down the soldiers pouring in as I made my way straight into the castle. For some reason, a bunch of shady-looking guys had started following behind me.
“Revolutionary reinforcements. This will be the end of the corrupt monarchy. Come, won’t you join hands with us?”
“I don’t know you.”
These guys seem fine to take down.
“Brionac X!”
“Gyaaaaah!”
I remember Father lamenting how there are always idiots who take advantage of the chaos. I’ve never seen a country improve after a coup.
“Come out already!”
“G-Get the dignitaries out of here as soon as possible! A monster is attacking!”

I don’t have much time. I need to meet with the queen quickly. But advancing without killing anyone is incredibly tedious. To top it off, they’re trying to take me down with ritual magic. Of course, I absorbed it with Absorb.
“Stop right there. Are you the one who wishes to speak with me?”

While I was fighting off the soldiers, the queen finally made her appearance. The soldiers cleared a path, and the queen stepped forward. Apparently, she had been in talks with the people of this country. She said it took time because of the blame-shifting and evacuation procedures.
“I apologize for keeping you waiting. Could you please lower your weapon?”
“I came here to talk. However, it was your soldiers who refused to listen.”
Is it just my imagination, or does the queen seem a little tense? I’m a gentleman. Father and Filo-tan told me to live sincerely, after all.
“…So, what do you need from me? First, could you tell me who you are?”
“I am one of the Four Holy Heroes, the Spear Hero, Kitamura Motoyasu. I was summoned yesterday in your country, Melromarc.”
The queen’s expression grew severe. She was probably trying to process a truth she had no knowledge of.
“Do you not believe me?”
“…In terms of strength, I can see that you possess power befitting the legends. However, I am somewhat skeptical about the claim that our country summoned the Four Holy Heroes…”
“It’s something that will become public knowledge in a few days anyway. Your husband and that useless princess colluded with the Three Heroes Church and caused this mess.”
“Our country… I was under the impression that the Three Heroes Church was a peaceful religion…”

What a ridiculous assumption. The Three Heroes Church is the root of all evil and has never produced anything but disaster. I’ve been burned by them countless times in previous loops. They must have kept everything hidden until now. But convincing someone that I’m looping is no easy task. However, if taking the queen with me can shatter the conspiracy against Father, I’ll do my best.
“May I ask you some questions?”
“Ask as many as you want. But do we have that much time?”
“Then… First, Melromarc is quite far from here. How did the hero summoned just yesterday manage to get here?”
“I used the hero’s teleportation skill to warp here instantly.”
She doesn’t believe me? The queen’s reaction was quiet.
“Next… According to legend, heroes are summoned at Level 1. But judging from your strength, you’re far stronger than that. How do you explain this?”
“I retained the levels I gained in a similar world, which is why I’m stronger than the other heroes right after being summoned.”

This explanation is easier to believe than trying to convince her that I’m looping. If I had some sort of secret code or proof, that would be ideal, but everything can be verified with a little investigation, making it hard to offer definitive proof. Of course, I already know the secret code from the queen herself.
“I see… Then, Sir Kitamura, the Spear Hero, would you accompany me to Faubrey and attend a meeting?”

“I don’t have time for that. Your husband, that useless princess, and the Three Heroes Church are conspiring to frame the Shield Hero. They’re even plotting to have the other heroes kill him. Can we afford to wait?”
“I will order my subordinates to stop them.”
“Are you capable of that?”
At my confident demeanor, the queen opened her fan and fell into deep thought. She’s one of the more reasonable queens. She should be able to grasp the danger posed by Trash’s reckless actions.
“By the way, Queen, what you were considering this morning was whether to give the new Philorial encyclopedia and research materials to your daughter—Melty, correct?”
The queen’s eyes widened.
“Why do you know that? Are you suggesting that the Spear Hero possesses mind-reading abilities? No, that’s not it.”
“…Very well. Since you know that much, what is it you want from me?”
“I want you to accompany me for one night and witness firsthand the events unfolding in Melromarc.”
I casually sent a party invitation to the queen. After some thought, she turned around.
“Summon Melty. We will depart shortly.”
After a short while, the princess arrived.
“Mother, what is going on?”
“It seems this man is the real Spear Hero. Either way, to avoid causing trouble for this country, we must act as hostages.”
“M-Mother…!”
The princess looked quite worried. This isn’t such a bad thing, so calm down. Filo-tan would be anxious otherwise.
“Once you accept the invitation, we’ll use the portal to warp to Melromarc.”
“Sir Kitamura, is this all the preparation we need?”
“Yes… but if possible, I’d prefer for you to keep a low profile. Wear a robe to conceal your status.”
“Understood. I will arrange it.”
“Also, bring two extra robes.”
“Understood.”
The queen and the princess donned robes and accepted my invitation.
“Then, Portal Spear!”

After leaving the castle, I used the skill to bring the queen and the princess to Melromarc. Now, the only thing left was to ensure that the queen properly witnessed everything happening in Melromarc.
